_readme: Free page read for College of the Canyons' census lever 8 (S691, reread worker). The prefix-alias census (kb/_prefix_alias_census.py, plan of 2026-11-14) held the pairs PSYCH to PSYC, POLISC to POLS and COMS to COMM at Canyons for want of a catalog-side title in committed files: its filed records place PSYC, POLS and COMM where the state's file lists PSYCH, POLISC and COMS. This read prints the 2026-27 catalog v3's course description pages for those three subjects, so each pair can be cited by the code, title and units the catalog prints. One load; robots.txt first, the census user agent.

questions.catalog_titles: The code, title and units the 2026-27 catalog prints for each PSYC, POLS and COMM course.
